verdict.rationale: The POS UI extensions docs direct developers to use the official Shopify CLI to scaffold POS extensions, so an official CLI exists for this product. The evidence covers only scaffolding extension configuration and files, in a single thin mention. Missing for 10: CLI commands for operating or managing POS (orders, inventory, staff, settings), AI or agent-oriented CLI workflows, in-depth CLI reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use Shopify CLI to scaffold your extension with the essential configuration and files.
